summary: Single-engine aircraft crashed on the Grand Mesa on Thursday, killing all three men aboard — pilot Dana Brewer, 49, of Clifton, and passengers Richard James "Jim" Platz, 47, of Fruita, and William Kennon, 47, of Collbran; the party had been searching for lost cattle. Mesa County Sheriff's Office and coroner responded; FAA en route to investigate.
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Coroner; FAA
notes: Filed per the aviation-fatality precedent (ids 2307/1031, 3044); date 2013-12-12 Thursday-weekday-verified; KVNF headline confirms "looking for lost cattle" purpose; cause under investigation per 95RockFM (parent-opened). NTSB-level aircraft details from unopened search snippet excluded.
